en: Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a broad tree-lined street bordered by two- and three‑story townhouses. The scene shows people walking and standing along the sidewalks and in the street. Large trees in the foreground frame the view. Printed text in red identifies the place as 'Innere Kamenzer-Strasse' in 'Königsbrück' and includes a publisher's line 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen' with a number '8951' and handwritten number '13085'.
